description: One ferry line by id from find_ferries: both ends with country, operator site and booking link, and a timetable digest from open GTFS feeds — next departures today in local time, sailings per day, daytime and night rhythm, weekdays over the next 8 days, crossing time. available: false means no open timetable is matched, not that the ferry does not run. Use it for when the next ferry leaves, how often it runs and how long the crossing takes.

id.description: Ferry line id from find_ferries, e.g. r5958961.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: get_ferry_schedule
title: Ferry Timetable
